inputs.text:
Create a professional cinematic character reference sheet for a realistic live-action character, designed specifically for use as a character reference in an AI video generation model.

**Character:**
white girl with blonde hair, athletic and physically capable, with a natural realistic appearance. She has a distinctive, memorable face with consistent facial proportions, realistic skin texture, expressive dark brown eyes, naturally shaped eyebrows, a defined but feminine jawline, and long blonde hair. Her appearance should feel like a real person rather than a fashion model or fantasy illustration.

**Reference Sheet Layout:**
Show the SAME character in multiple clearly separated views on one clean reference sheet:

1. Front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait
2. 3/4 facial view
3. Full left profile
4. Full right profile
5. Front-facing full-body view
6. Sideway full-body view
7. Rear full-body view

**Wardrobe:**
wears a simple, fitted, neutral-colored contemporary outfit with minimal visual distractions. The clothing should clearly show her body proportions and silhouette without being revealing. No hats, sunglasses, jewelry, weapons, armor, or accessories.

**Photography / Visual Style:**
Photorealistic live-action character photography.
Ultra-realistic human skin.
Natural pores and subtle skin imperfections.
Realistic hair strands.
Realistic eyes and facial detail.
Natural studio lighting.
Soft neutral background.
Professional film-production character reference photography.
High facial detail.
Sharp focus.
Natural color grading.
No fantasy illustration aesthetic.

**Composition:**
Clean neutral gray or off-white studio background.
Even consistent lighting across every view.
Minimal shadows.
No environmental background.
No props.
No text.
No logos.
No decorative graphics.


High realism, consistent anatomy, consistent hairstyle, consistent wardrobe, cinematic live-action quality, production-ready character reference.
